description: This file is a Java interface named ContentService that defines various service methods related to content management in a CMS, including operations for listing, retrieving, saving, updating, and removing content and associated files for merchant stores.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by content type, merchant store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object based on a code, merchant store, and optionally language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a Content object.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Stores a content file for a merchant store, typically in Infinispan cache.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Stores a list of content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific content file identified by name and type from a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a particular content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Returns all content files linked to a merchant store for a specific content type.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Returns names of all content files for a merchant store and content type.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo image for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType (overloaded)
methods.description: Lists Content objects by type for a merchant store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Returns descriptions of content types by type, store, and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and URL.
